title: October 2026 Catchup — All items
note: Consolidated from 30 daily digests across the month. Items deduped by slug; ranked by recurring presence.

items.hook: 103k+ stars, Day 4. Lifecycle hooks (SessionStart through SessionEnd) capture every tool call, compress observations into semantic summaries, and store them in SQLite + Chroma. Future sessions retrieve relevant context via hybrid semantic/keyword search — the project claims 10x token savings vs re-reading raw context. Works across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenClaw.
